GreenOCR-Dataset
	

Synthetic document pages for training OCR / document-parsing models, mainly Vietnamese with an English counterpart. Each page comes with
exact ground truth (block polygons and content) and a ready-to-train target in the LightOnOCR-3 grounding format. The pages are rendered,
not real scans; the augment parts are degraded variants (scan / phone / old-paper look).
Every type has three parts: vi and en (clean pages) and augment (degraded pages, Vietnamese and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/GreenNode/GreenOCR-Dataset.
